rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the long outer garment or cape worn over the shoulders.

example.english: Put your cloak back on if you’re cold.
example.jyutping: dung3 can1 zau6 pei1 faan2 gin6 pei1 fung1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a figurative covering or protection, including something used as a cover or pretext.

example.english: They used the volunteer event as a cloak to secretly move the goods.
example.traditional: 佢哋以義工活動做掩護，偷偷運走啲貨。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ji5 ji6 gung1 wut6 dung6 zou6 jim2 wu6 tau1 tau1 wan6 zau2 di1 fo3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the cloak is a disguise or false appearance rather than a cover or pretext.

example.english: This disguise was such an effective cloak that even people who knew me did not recognize me.
example.traditional: 呢套偽裝幾逼真，連熟人都認唔出我。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 ngai6 zong1 gei2 bik1 zan1 lin4 suk6 jan4 dou1 jan6 m4 ceot1 ngo5
